sqlMap.select: SELECT PERMISSION_ID, PERMISSION_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM PERMISSIONS ORDER BY PERMISSION_NAME
SELECT PERMISSION_ID, PERMISSION_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM PERMISSIONS WHERE PERMISSION_ID = #permissionId#

SELECT DISTINCT P.PERMISSION_ID, P.PERMISSION_NAME, P.DESCRIPTION FROM PERMISSIONS P INNER JOIN ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP ON P.PERMISSION_ID = RP.PERMISSION_ID INNER JOIN USERS U ON U.ROLE_ID = RP.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #userId#

SELECT PERMISSION_ID, PERMISSION_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM PERMISSIONS
PERMISSION_NAME LIKE #name#
